evals.name: regulated-invoice-intake
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/invoice-intake.yaml to brief.yaml, plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/invoice-intake.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and every file under plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/invoice-intake/ and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/records/invoice-intake/security.yaml into decisions/ (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there activating the pack at context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp) and set spec.context_packs to [regulated-corp] in the brief. Then, as the UX expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/decisions/ux.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area ux, metadata.author forjate:ux, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: No surface at Crawl (cli/none), a custom review page served by review-api at Walk behind oauth2-proxy matching the architecture and security records, token checkpoints for mismatch approval naming post_to_erp, Formbricks only from Walk, an asynchronous latency budget (the clerk never waits on extraction), failure lines for parse failure and Odoo down, an escalation context the verify Job can assert, a walkthrough as a manual gate.

assertions.text: ux.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case (incl. cross-record consistency)

assertions.expr: setting('surface','crawl') in ('cli','none','notebook')
assertions.text: no screen invented at Crawl

assertions.expr: setting('surface','walk') in ('custom-web','existing-tool') and (setting('surface_workload','walk') == 'review-api' or setting('surface','walk') == 'existing-tool')
assertions.text: Walk surface is the review page the architecture serves (or the ERP's own UI)

assertions.expr: setting('auth_in_front','walk') == 'oauth2-proxy' and setting('auth_in_front','crawl') == 'none'
assertions.text: auth_in_front agrees with the architecture and security records

assertions.expr: any('[token]' in x and has('post_to_erp|approv', x) for x in listed(setting('hitl_checkpoints','walk')))
assertions.text: a token checkpoint issues the approval post_to_erp requires

assertions.expr: any(has('mismatch|differs|amount', x) for x in listed(setting('hitl_checkpoints','walk')))
assertions.text: the mismatch exception has a checkpoint

assertions.expr: 'apps/surveys/formbricks' not in choices('crawl') and setting('feedback_capture','crawl') in ('verify-job-log','none')
assertions.text: no feedback widget at Crawl

assertions.expr: setting('feedback_capture','walk') in ('formbricks','review-queue-flag') and (setting('feedback_capture','walk') != 'formbricks' or 'apps/surveys/formbricks' in choices('walk'))
assertions.text: feedback captured on the page from Walk, Formbricks listed when chosen

assertions.expr: has('[0-9]', setting('latency_budget','walk')) and has('async|never waits|queue|refresh', setting('latency_budget','walk'))
assertions.text: latency budget with numbers and an asynchronous queue, not a spinner

assertions.expr: any(has('parse', x) for x in listed(setting('failure_ux','walk'))) and any(has('odoo|erp|post', x) for x in listed(setting('failure_ux','walk')))
assertions.text: failure UX covers parse failure and the ERP being down

assertions.expr: has('reason', setting('escalation_context','crawl')) and has('po|purchase', setting('escalation_context','crawl'))
assertions.text: escalation context names the reason and the PO values at Crawl

assertions.expr: any(((g.get('check') or {}).get('type')) == 'verify-job' for g in gates('crawl'))
assertions.text: a verify-job gate proves the escalation context

assertions.expr: any(((g.get('check') or {}).get('type')) == 'manual' and has('clerk|walkthrough|sign', g.get('text')) for g in gates('walk')) or has('walkthrough|shadow', setting('onboarding','walk'))
assertions.text: adoption: a walkthrough with the clerks, as a manual gate or onboarding line

assertions.expr: any(has('open-webui|open webui|chat', a.get('option')) for a in alts())
assertions.text: a chat front-end is a rejected alternative, with a reason

evals.name: chat-copilot-no-packs
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/support-copilot/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/support-copilot.yaml to brief.yaml, plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/support-copilot.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and every file under plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/support-copilot/ and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/records/support-copilot/security.yaml into decisions/ (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there with an empty pack list (spec.packs: []) and set spec.context_packs to [] in the brief. Then, as the UX expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/support-copilot/.builder/decisions/ux.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area ux, metadata.author forjate:ux, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: Replay at Crawl with no surface, Telegram as the Walk surface served by agent-api with api-key matching the architecture record, deterministic handoffs for refunds and cancellations (no token), in-channel feedback instead of Formbricks, typing indicator and a per-turn budget, failure lines for the orders API down and the webhook outage, the plan's G-UX-1 carried verbatim, a shadow period as a manual gate, a question on group visibility or on a review UI.

assertions.text: ux.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case (incl. cross-record consistency)

assertions.expr: 'run' not in stages
assertions.text: no decision for the Run stage the plan skipped

assertions.expr: setting('surface','walk') == 'chat-channel' and has('telegram', setting('channel','walk'))
assertions.text: Walk surface is the Telegram channel

assertions.expr: setting('surface','crawl') in ('cli','none')
assertions.text: no screen at Crawl: the replay is the surface

assertions.expr: setting('auth_in_front','walk') == 'api-key' or any(has('api-key', q.get('question')) and has('oauth2', q.get('question')) for q in oq())
assertions.text: auth_in_front agrees with the architecture (api-key) or the disagreement is an open question naming both values

assertions.expr: any(has('refund|cancel', x) and '[deterministic]' in x for x in listed(setting('hitl_checkpoints','walk')))
assertions.text: refunds and cancellations are deterministic handoffs, not token approvals

assertions.expr: not any(txt(x).strip().endswith('[token]') for x in listed(setting('hitl_checkpoints','walk')))
assertions.text: no token checkpoint: no tool requires an approval token

assertions.expr: setting('feedback_capture','walk') == 'in-channel' and 'apps/surveys/formbricks' not in choices()
assertions.text: feedback in the channel, not a web survey

assertions.expr: setting('streaming','walk') == 'typing-indicator' and has('[0-9]', setting('latency_budget','walk'))
assertions.text: typing indicator and a numeric per-turn budget

assertions.expr: any(has('orders? api|lookup', x) for x in listed(setting('failure_ux','walk'))) and any(has('webhook|duplicate', x) for x in listed(setting('failure_ux','walk')))
assertions.text: failure UX covers the orders API down and the webhook outage

assertions.expr: any(g.get('id') == 'G-UX-1' and has('transcript', g.get('text')) and has('order id', g.get('text')) for g in gates('walk'))
assertions.text: the plan's G-UX-1 is carried with its text

assertions.expr: has('transcript', setting('escalation_context','crawl')) and has('order', setting('escalation_context','crawl'))
assertions.text: escalation context has the transcript and the order id

assertions.expr: any(((g.get('check') or {}).get('type')) == 'manual' and has('shadow|agent|sign', g.get('text')) for g in gates('walk')) or has('shadow|mirror', setting('onboarding','walk'))
assertions.text: a shadow period with the agents, as a manual gate or onboarding line

assertions.expr: any(has('group|private|visib', q.get('question')) or has('review ui|ui of their own|agents', q.get('question')) for q in oq())
assertions.text: asks about group visibility or a review UI for the agents

evals.name: negative-nightly-batch-no-ui
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/invoice-intake.yaml to brief.yaml, plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/invoice-intake.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and every file under plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/invoice-intake/ and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/records/invoice-intake/security.yaml into decisions/ (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there activating the pack at context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp) and set spec.context_packs to [regulated-corp] in the brief. Change of plan from the requester: nobody approves anything any more; mismatches are written to a nightly CSV report dropped in the shared folder for finance ops to look at when they get to it. It is a nightly batch, no UI is needed; the record should reflect that. Then, as the UX expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/decisions/ux.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area ux, metadata.author forjate:ux, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: No screen is invented: surface none or cli at every stage, no Open WebUI, no Formbricks. But the exception path is named: the CSV in the shared folder is recorded as the surface for mismatches, with what it lacks (no token, no per-person audit, nothing posts without a person) as a risk or an open question for finance ops; failure UX says where a failed batch is seen and who is told.

assertions.text: ux.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case (incl. cross-record consistency)

assertions.expr: all(setting('surface', s) in ('none','cli','existing-tool') for s in stages)
assertions.text: no custom page or chat UI at any stage

assertions.expr: 'apps/ai-models/open-webui' not in choices() and 'apps/surveys/formbricks' not in choices()
assertions.text: no UI or survey component

assertions.expr: any(has('csv|shared folder|report', x) for x in listed(setting('hitl_checkpoints','walk')) + listed(setting('audiences','walk')) + listed(setting('escalation_context','walk')))
assertions.text: the CSV in the shared folder is recorded as the exception surface

assertions.expr: any(has('token|audit|approv|post', r.get('text')) for r in risks()) or any(has('token|audit|approv|post', q.get('question')) for q in oq())
assertions.text: what the CSV lacks (token, per-person audit, who approves a posting) is a risk or an open question

assertions.expr: any(has('fail|batch|nightly', x) and has('alert|email|log|notif|see', x) for x in listed(setting('failure_ux','walk')))
assertions.text: a failed nightly batch is seen by someone

assertions.expr: not any(txt(x).strip().endswith('[token]') for x in listed(setting('hitl_checkpoints','walk')))
assertions.text: no token checkpoint is invented for a flow nobody approves

assertions.expr: any(has('open-webui|open webui|review page|custom|web', a.get('option')) for a in alts())
assertions.text: a page or a chat UI is listed as rejected, with the reason

evals.name: pack-no-custom-ui
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/invoice-intake.yaml to brief.yaml, plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/invoice-intake.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and every file under plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/invoice-intake/ and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/records/invoice-intake/security.yaml into decisions/ (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there activating two packs, context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp) and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/packs/no-custom-ui (name no-custom-ui), and set spec.context_packs to [regulated-corp, no-custom-ui] in the brief. Then, as the UX expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/decisions/ux.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area ux, metadata.author forjate:ux, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: No Formbricks anywhere (UX-1 cited, feedback moves to a review-queue flag or the ERP's own tool), no custom-web and no Open WebUI at Walk (UX-2 cited): approvals move into Odoo's own UI as an existing-tool surface with the token path raised as an open question caused by UX-2, or the surface is left unset for Walk with the question; the checkpoints and the escalation context stay; the rejected default is in alternatives.

assertions.text: ux.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case (incl. cross-record consistency)

assertions.expr: 'apps/surveys/formbricks' not in choices() and all(setting('feedback_capture', s) != 'formbricks' for s in stages)
assertions.text: respects UX-1: no Formbricks
UX-1 cited

assertions.expr: setting('surface','walk') not in ('custom-web','open-webui')
assertions.text: respects UX-2: no custom front-end at Walk
UX-2 cited

assertions.expr: setting('surface','walk') == 'existing-tool' or (setting('surface','walk') is None and any(q.get('caused_by_rule') == 'pack:no-custom-ui#UX-2' for q in oq()))
assertions.text: approvals move into the ERP's own UI, or the surface is left open with a question caused by UX-2

assertions.expr: any(has('token|approv|validat', q.get('question')) for q in oq())
assertions.text: the approval token path through the existing tool is an open question

assertions.expr: any(has('custom|review page|web', a.get('option')) for a in alts())
assertions.text: the custom review page is recorded as the rejected default

assertions.expr: any(has('mismatch|differs|amount', x) for x in listed(setting('hitl_checkpoints','walk')))
assertions.text: the mismatch checkpoint survives the surface change

assertions.expr: setting('feedback_capture','walk') in ('review-queue-flag','in-channel','none') or setting('feedback_capture','walk') is None
assertions.text: feedback moves to a channel the organisation owns
